docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,550.00 FILED BY HICKS, KIANNA AS TO DEFENDANT PATTON, RICK ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-02-2017 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FEE FOR SERVICE: $55.00 SERVED APR-15-2017, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT PATTON, RICK
STIPULATION FOR HEARING BEFORE PRO TEM COMMISSIONER FILED BY HICKS, KIANNA PATTON, RICK

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE; CASE SETTLED. RICHARD GALLIONI A MANAGING PARTNER AND THE EMPLOYER OF THE DEFENDANT INFORMED THE COURT THAT THE WRONG PARTY WAS SUED. THE PLAINTIFF, DEFENDANT AND MR. GALLIONI MET AND COFERRED AND AN AGREEMENT WAS REACHED. PARTIES REPORTED THAT MR. GALLIONI GAVE THE PLAINTIFF A CHECK AND PARTIES AGREE THAT THE CASE WAS SETTLED AND REQUESTED THAT THE CASE BE DISMISSED. PLAINTIFF KIANNA HICKS IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT RICK PATTON IS PRESENT. RICHARD GALLIONI, MANAGING PARTNER IS ALSO PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: DIANNE PEEBLES; CLERK: J. MURPHY; NOT REPORTED. (506)
ORDER RE: DISMISSAL. CASE SETTLED (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS)
